I don't even know why they bother saving the two dollars. My brother said the exact same thing about his supplier, he works out in Florida now. I could never do Florida, though, the humidity is just unbearable. 

But... wait, what was I saying? 

Right, the work orders. Yeah, the forgotten follow-ups have just piled up so much lately. It's gotten really bad. My supervisor Dave—he's a good guy, usually pretty laid back, always brings these amazing apple fritters from that bakery on 5th street on Fridays—he basically told me I had to come see a doctor.
